notes: Native Pages Jev is a verified false completion: the final Body value was empty.
Native TextEdit Jev, Luna, and hybrid exact text were verified in the native text area.
Native Spotify is a desktop Electron/web surface and is labeled separately from pure native apps.
Native Keynote and Numbers are pure native Apple app tests: Luna passed both; synchronized Jev reruns failed with blank Keynote placeholders and an empty Numbers table.
The separate accessibility-driver control passed Pages visually but failed Keynote, Numbers, and Spotify controls; it is a driver capability check, not a model leaderboard lane.
Matched native hybrid now covers all five tasks at 5/5: Jev directly passed only TextEdit, while Luna repaired the native misses.
The new native hybrid totals are estimated from the observed Jev leg plus 11 Keynote and 3 Numbers Luna CUA calls at the calibrated proxy rate; they are not provider invoices.
The deterministic browser controls passed 14/14 probes and replayed Jev failures at 42/42; they are not model runs and are not merged into any of the four approach scores.
The exact ten-task real-world browser rerun is now scored: Jev 0/10, Luna 7/10, and a matched Jev-first replay 7/10; the replay is explicitly not one interleaved live turn.
Known Luna CUA-call proxy for the exact rerun is about $0.1876 across the United/OpenTable/continuation traces; the Drive hang's final usage was not returned, so this is a lower-bound known proxy.
The exact rerun's nine non-hung tasks average about 98.7 seconds; Drive remained on a non-matching search result beyond 20 minutes and is reported as a hang.

A clean 149.1s Chrome-foreground Luna TodoMVC recording verified a multi-step add/complete/filter workflow before the exact ten-task rerun; the exact rerun now supersedes that earlier partial denominator.
The retained 60.0s Luna United v2 clip reaches a concrete itinerary and traveler/payment boundary; it intentionally stops before identity, payment, or purchase.
A clean 149.1s Chrome-foreground Luna OpenTable clip reaches the named Hed Very Thai reservation-details page and Complete reservation button, then releases the temporary hold without submitting.
Three labeled browser composites now show Jev-first to Luna recovery for United, OpenTable, and TodoMVC; they are task-level evidence, not one uninterrupted live handoff or a full ten-task aggregate.
The clean long-form Luna recordings are 141.0s and 130.9s browser captures of search/results flows; neither is a completed booking.
Luna also has a new 119.0s full-screen native TextEdit capture with approximately 75s of active work and a visible stopwatch overlay.
The old 180s United capture was excluded after frame inspection because the foreground switched away from the browser.
The exploratory public CUA lane is 9 repeated read-only Flights/OpenTable/Resy flows: Jev Browser 3/9, Jev Ultrafast 1/9, Luna 9/9; hybrid was not run on that exact lane.

The auxiliary Wikipedia and GitHub research rows were completed in one serialized Luna Chrome follow-up: Luna passed both, and the hybrid retained the already-passing Jev leg without invoking fallback.
Authenticated Agent-Native evidence is a separate denominator: Jev Ultrafast 1/8 exact tasks, Luna 5/5 safe composite checkpoints, and no matched authenticated hybrid run.
Controlled fixture text used a scripted helper; Ultrafast used a small text model for literal strings after Jev target selection; native Jev used task-supplied literal strings.

A fresh file-upload-capable Playwright control passed the upload fixture 3/3 at 320, 310, and 298 ms ($0 local cost); three model-directed normal-Chrome Luna reruns and three Jev-first Hybrid recovery reruns also passed the upload fixture, supporting connected-Chrome 42/42 for both alongside each original in-app-browser 39/42.
Captioned retained videos were rebuilt with labels and timers in a reserved bottom band outside the recorded app surface.

The new 4m59s Luna Chrome-window recording succeeds at five visible safe checkpoints: Mail draft, Calendar draft/cancel, Content editing, Design generation, and Slides editing; it is supplemental evidence, not a new benchmark score.

The prior 5m21s companion was a stitched composite and is excluded from the video library. The retained Hybrid-filtered fallback is a 3m54s trimmed v7 capture covering fresh Mail, Calendar, Content, and Design generation; Slides was not reached and the direct Jev bridge leg was not independently scored, so it is marked Fail and excluded from the Hybrid score.
Two short Jev authenticated-app clips end shortly after the final action with the stopping state in a reserved bottom band; both are marked Fail and do not change the score.
The preferred v8 one-take was rejected after frame review because its eight-minute cap ended during fresh Design generation before Slides; it remains in attempts, not the curated library.
